requests: Apply VMS soundfont changes while running

implementation.follow: F8 import/Windows-auto enables following; manual custom file/direct MIDI disables it; F8 toggle/persistence.
implementation.detection: Saved VMS config active-font set and chosen SF2 size/mtime,500ms polling/two stable observations; parse failures break debounce. Unsaved in-memory VMS UI changes not detectable.
implementation.swap: Pause at consumed source position, prepare separate new decoder and seek on worker with UI message pumping, publish only after preparation. Prepared decoder starts at original source-frame base with saved initial channel states before prefill. Restore playing/paused state and persist selected path.
implementation.failure: Missing/corrupt new bank leaves old decoder and resumes its prior playing state; suppress repeated unchanged failing fingerprint. No VMS settings or source-bank writes.
implementation.timing: ~1s detection plus loading/seek time. Brief audio pause possible, no seamless crossfade.

full_CTest.scope: Before final debounce reset and short mode label; affected final tests below

tests.audio: Dummy/owned config and banks only; no actual VMS/user config modifications or physical listening.

limits: Only saved Apply/OK config changes; one selected active font, not simultaneous layered banks or VMS mixer/effects.
Keeps current selected bank if still present in a multiple-enabled list; otherwise F8 selection is required.
Large SF2/dense MIDI seek can make the loading pause longer.
Existing metadata-end/past-tail playback is not re-seeked on font change; active-song switching tested.
Forced OOM/device loss and source write during initial load not injected.
